comments.body: About testing, I'd like to discuss how we plan to do integration tests between clients and any plan for a devnet.
This meeting occurred more than 24 hours ago. Closing automatically.

FOCIL moves closer to its first devnet.

### Spec Updates

* **[Jihoon](https://github.com/jihoonsong)** opened a [CL spec PR](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5138) that revises inclusion list deadlines, making the protocol simpler and easier to reason about while preserving its behavior.

* **[Felix](https://github.com/felix314159)** from STEEL opened and merged an [EL spec PR](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/2643) that introduces the framework changes required for FOCIL testing and adds a set of EL test cases. Client teams can now run these tests against their implementations.

### Development Updates

* **Besu** has all the FOCIL code in place and is currently writing unit tests, with plans to integrate the EEST test cases next.

* **Lodestar** has no new updates.

### FOCIL Devnet Planning

* **[Fabio](https://github.com/fab-10)** proposed using the Interop to align on the fork base and the set of EIPs to include.

* The group agreed that FOCIL devnets will be based on `glamsterdam-devnet-0` specs.

### Links

- [CL spec - Update FOCIL deadlines](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5138)
- [EL spec - FOCIL framework and basic tests](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/2643)
